invariants.rationale: labelAlign is likely to be a bitmask/alignment constant, typically a non-negative int representing alignment.
lineAlign is likely derived from alignment constants in Align, so it should be non-negative.
lineAlign should not typically have both left and right bits set at the same time for alignment.
labelAlign and lineAlign are conceptually used for different alignment axes and may often differ.
lineAlign should represent a horizontal alignment and must match one of the valid alignment bits.
